_about: Quests the setting "Skip slow quests" (behavior.skipSlow, off by default) leaves out of the leveling guides: ones that cost far more time than they pay. A hand-written list: a row needs 2 or more sources that agree (a forum thread, a community guide, an XP-per-minute list), a review date and a one-line reason. Blizzard changes drop rates in hotfixes, so review a row after 30 days (`slowquests report` lists the old ones). `slow`: the quests of one chain, left out together; a quest that a quest still worth doing needs stays (Own.slowNeeds). `code`: why (low-drop, slow-respawn, slow-xp). A `low-drop` row also carries a score: its XP over the minutes the quest takes, set against the median of quests of its 3 level band, both from forever-db (kills x 0.25 minute, an item objective needs count over the best drop chance in kills). A row whose score reaches `margin` times that median is overruled: the data says it is not slow, and the build leaves it out of the addon and prints it. A row of another code is never scored, since walks, respawns and crowds are not in the data. `keep`: a quest the community calls slow that is not (the XP pays, or the route does it beside other work): documented here, and the build refuses a quest in both lists. `covered`: quests sources call slow that another setting already handles. `watch`: candidates short of 2 sources. `level`: the quests that turn slow as the character outlevels them, from forever-db alone with no row needed. At each player level a quest's reward at the level-gap share, plus the XP of the kills it asks, over the minutes of its work, is a share of that level's XP bar. A quest whose share falls under `threshold` times the median of the quests a character of that level does (quest level 3 below to 2 above) is left out from that level up, when it was not under it at its own level and the character is `fromGap` levels or more above the quest (6: where Forever starts to cut the reward) (a quest slow at its own level is in a guide for a reason). Never a quest of a row, of `keep` or a class quest. `slowquests build` writes Core/SlowQuestList.lua.

slow.name: Guile of the Raptor
slow.why: The raptor item drops about 3 to 4 percent in play (one player: 3 of 12 in 2 hours, 30 players tagging 14 spawn points); the data says 33 percent.

sources.note: Blizzard forum thread on quests that cannot be completed
a community leveling guide's skip list for Arathi Highlands (Horde)

slow.name: Wastewander Justice and More Wastewander Justice
slow.why: The Wastewander mobs respawn slowly under crowds; a community list counts 358 XP per minute against a Tanaris median of 1,309.

sources.note: Blizzard forum thread on crowded quest zones
a community list of quests under 60 percent of the usual XP per minute

slow.name: Mok'thardin's Enchantment
slow.why: The Pristine Tigress Fang needs 100 or more tiger kills; the chain pays 11,700 XP over four parts.

sources.note: Blizzard forum thread on the worst Classic quests
a community Stranglethorn guide: the fang drops when it feels like it

keep.name: Toxic Horrors
keep.why: One guide skips it; another notes Forever pays 5,800 XP (Classic 4,134). The data scores it 2.6 times the band median.

keep.name: Consumed by Hatred
keep.why: 60 tusks is slow alone, but they drop from every Bristleback that Tribes at War asks for (40 percent each), so the route does both at once (data/route-fixes.json, issue 957).

keep.name: Troll Witchery
keep.why: One player reports 4 hours without a drop; the data says 80 percent and the guide keeps it on purpose (Alliance 30-40/04b). One source only, so it stays.

covered.name: Rin'ji is Trapped!
covered.why: An escort: the player already answers it (Own.escortChoice).

covered.name: OOX-09/HL and OOX-22/FE
covered.why: Marked optional in the guides, and behavior.rareDrops handles the item start.

covered.name: Sunken Treasure, Death From Below
covered.why: Escorts and a group choice in the Arathi guide.

watch.name: Chillwind Horns, Return to Tinkee
watch.why: One guide skips both; another only says the delivery to Burning Steppes is not worth a trip. 4810 is not in a leveling guide.

watch.name: Message to the Wildhammer chain, Ripple Recovery
watch.why: One forum post (2026-11-22); other guides route them.

watch.name: Helcular's Revenge
watch.why: Three Classic-era sources (2019), none about Forever's drop rate.
